summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Production Daily Report Edit, Delete, and Revision History features. Backend history tracking with field-level diffs working correctly. Frontend Aksi column with Edit/Riwayat/Hapus buttons fully functional.

minor_issues.issue: Attendance validation blocks editing existing reports when operator wasn't marked present on that date
minor_issues.impact: Expected behavior - enforces attendance validation. Edit works when operator/date unchanged or operator was marked present.

observations.observation: History modal shows 'Belum ada riwayat' (No history yet) for reports created before history feature was implemented
observations.impact: Expected - only new reports and edits after feature deployment will have history entries

passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/production/reports creates report with initial history entry (action='create')
Backend: PUT /api/production/reports/{id} appends history with field-level changes (action='edit')
Backend: GET /api/production/reports/masterlist returns items with history array
Backend: Update without changes does NOT add history entry (correct behavior)
Backend: DELETE /api/production/reports/{id} soft-deletes report (removed from masterlist)
Backend: Field-level diff tracking captures 6 changed fields correctly (process, qty_ok, qty_ng, work_end, machine_no, remarks)
Backend: Unchanged fields are NOT recorded in history (correct behavior)
Frontend: Login and navigation to Daily Production Report page working
Frontend: Masterlist table displays with filter functionality (SO 005200 filter shows 4 rows)
Frontend: Aksi column present with Edit, Riwayat (History), and Hapus (Delete) buttons for Production/Admin users
Frontend: Edit modal (ml-edit-modal) opens with all form fields (date, operator, SO, customer, process, qty_ok, qty_ng, work_start, work_end, machine_no, remarks)
Frontend: History modal (ml-history-modal) opens and displays 'Riwayat Perubahan' (Revision History)
Frontend: Delete confirmation modal (ml-delete-modal) opens with proper confirmation text and Cancel/Hapus buttons
Frontend: All modals close properly when Cancel/Close buttons clicked

success_percentage.backend: 90% (9/10 tests passed - 1 expected failure due to attendance validation)
success_percentage.frontend: 100% (All UI components and modals working correctly)

backend_history_tracking.create_action: ✅ New reports get initial history entry with action='create', by_name, at timestamp, and empty changes array
backend_history_tracking.edit_action: ✅ Updates append history entry with action='edit', by_name, at timestamp, and changes[] array containing field-level diffs
backend_history_tracking.field_diff_tracking: ✅ Only changed fields recorded with from/to values. Tested 6 field changes: process, qty_ok, qty_ng, work_end, machine_no, remarks
backend_history_tracking.unchanged_fields: ✅ Unchanged fields (operator_name, so_no, customer, work_start) correctly NOT recorded in changes array
backend_history_tracking.no_change_update: ✅ Update with no actual changes does NOT add history entry (prevents noise)
backend_history_tracking.masterlist_history: ✅ GET /production/reports/masterlist returns items with complete history array

frontend_aksi_column.column_visibility: ✅ Aksi column visible for Production/Admin users (canEdit check working)
frontend_aksi_column.edit_button: ✅ Edit button (ml-edit-{id}) present and clickable, opens edit modal
frontend_aksi_column.history_button: ✅ Riwayat button (ml-history-{id}) present with badge count for edited reports, opens history modal
frontend_aksi_column.delete_button: ✅ Hapus button (ml-delete-{id}) present and clickable, opens delete confirmation modal

frontend_modals.edit_modal: ✅ Opens with data-testid='ml-edit-modal', displays all form fields, Save button (edit-save-btn) and Cancel button working
frontend_modals.history_modal: ✅ Opens with data-testid='ml-history-modal', displays history entries with action badges (Dibuat/Diedit) and field changes (from → to)
frontend_modals.delete_modal: ✅ Opens with data-testid='ml-delete-modal', shows confirmation text with report details, Batal and Hapus (ml-delete-confirm) buttons working
